notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). StrategyWiki has a stub page (completion stage 0). Its Table of Contents is the only written subpage; it lists Gameplay, Controls, Walkthrough and six level pages (The Shed, The Tree, Rose's Room, Cuckoo Clock, Snow Globe, The Attic), none written. The chapters use those level names in that order only; no text copied, and the real play order needs checking. The table was not added to sw-structure.json. ittakestwo.fandom.com has an "It Takes Two" page, but the API returned no linked articles for it. Steam app 1426210 is "It Takes Two"; app 2995920 is "It Takes Two Friend's Pass". Only 20 Steam achievements, 2 hidden. Their texts are jokes that do not name a level, so 16 sit in Secrets and Gags, "Minigame Megalomania" has its own chapter,; "It Took Two" ("You did it!") and the 2 hidden ones sit in The Attic as a placeholder.
